projects.name: Terminal-Based-Wordle
projects.description: A terminal-based Wordle game built in Java that uses a live API to load random 5-letter words. Players have 6 attempts to guess the hidden word with color-style feedback for correct and misplaced letters.
projects.longDescription: A terminal-based Wordle game built in Java that uses a live API to load random 5-letter words. Players have 6 attempts to guess the hidden word with color-style feedback for correct and misplaced letters.

projects.name: Nolan-s-Personal-Website
projects.description: A personal portfolio website built with React, TypeScript, and Vite to showcase projects, experience, and technical skills. The site dynamically pulls GitHub repository data through the GitHub API and includes a dedicated resume page for easy access to professional information.
